blind_target.evidence_quote: This study evaluated a previously demonstrated effective Canadian campus MHL resource in a UK student sample.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Addressing Mental Health Literacy in a UK university campus population: Positive replication of a Canadian intervention
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The title explicitly declares a positive replication, supported by the abstract reporting improved knowledge, reduced stigma and increased help-seeking intent. Target identity uncertainty does not lower outcome confidence.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract confirms a UK evaluation of Transitions but does not establish which earlier empirical finding is retested. References include Kutcher, Wei & Morgan (2016c), the supplied row 112, and Potvin-Boucher et al. (2010), both plausibly related to intervention effectiveness. Full primary context describing the earlier evaluation and the finding tested is needed to identify the target and determine representation.
